title: MMAFFBen: A Multilingual and Multimodal Affective Analysis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs and VLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot model performance metrics (e.g., F1 scores, Pearson correlation) on sentiment and emotion analysis tasks across 35 different languages to identify English-centric performance disparities.

Evaluating and comparing affective analysis performance across image and video datasets sourced from different geographic and cultural regions (e.g., Eastern/Chinese datasets like CFAPS versus Western datasets) to identify representation or performance skews.
